decisions.reason: As a somewhat peripheral but ergonomically credible line, the desk lamp is likely to be retained while a large firm with slack continues to see whether its results meet aspiration levels.
This general interior luminaire sits squarely in the firm's core building-lighting business, and the G2 platform logic suggests performance is likely close enough to aspirations to keep it.

Because this pendant luminaire is presented as a flagship aligned with the firm's strategic move toward efficient, advanced lighting, there is little reason to expect withdrawal absent a clear performance shortfall.

The marine HMI searchlight is a narrow specialist product with weaker fit to the firm's LED- and intelligent-lighting direction, so if its results are below aspirations management would likely reallocate resources to stronger lines and new development.

This marine searchlight remains consistent with the firm's specialist-lighting capabilities, and without a strong signal of underperformance a large established manufacturer would usually keep it on the market.
